title: WabbleSpec Library Platform Receipt
description: Extends base receipt schema for Library/Package platform activation and gate verification.

registry.description: Primary package registry declared in design-document

semver_policy_declared.description: Semver policy (MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH definitions) declared in design-document

public_api_surface_declared.description: Public exports explicitly declared — internal modules excluded from public API

spec_template_variant.description: Fixed: library — confirms Library templates were used, not generic

tree_shaking_verified.description: Gate 4 passed: named exports, no top-level side effects, sideEffects field declared

bundle_size_within_budget.description: Gate 5 passed: minified+gzipped bundle within declared budget

peer_deps_declared.description: All peer dependencies declared with version ranges in package manifest

verification_gates_failed.description: Gate IDs that failed. Must be empty before Delivery wave.
